summary: This short wiki note is a stub about Carlos Anwandter, a German political exile. It states that he was born in Luckenwalde, Prussia, and died in Valdivia, Chile, in July 1889. It says he emigrated to Valdivia in 1850 after taking part in the Revolutions of 1848. The note gives two different birth dates, 1 April 1801 in the header and 8 April 1801 in the body, and it contains no further biography.
one_line: Carlos Anwandter was a German political exile from Prussia who emigrated to Valdivia, Chile, in 1850 after the Revolutions of 1848.
key_facts: Carlos Anwandter was a German political exile.
Carlos Anwandter emigrated to Valdivia, Chile, in 1850.
Carlos Anwandter participated in the Revolutions of 1848.
Carlos Anwandter was born in Luckenwalde, Prussia.
The note's header gives Carlos Anwandter's birth date as 1 April 1801.
The note's body gives Carlos Anwandter's birth date as 8 April 1801, which conflicts with the header date of 1 April 1801.
Carlos Anwandter died in Valdivia, Chile, on 10 July 1889.
The note contains no biographical details beyond birthplace, death place, dates and emigration.
